description: This Java class 'AndroidArtifactUtil' provides utility methods for handling Android artifacts within the IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment, including checking for Android packages, retrieving associated Android facets, and module selection dialogs.

classes.name: AndroidArtifactUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing Android artifacts, including package containment checks, related artifact verification, facet retrieval, and module selection.

methods.name: containsAndroidPackage
methods.description: Checks if the given artifact contains an Android package element.

methods.name: isRelatedArtifact
methods.description: Determines if the artifact is related to the specified module, specifically if it is an Android application artifact associated with that module.

methods.name: getPackagedFacet
methods.description: Retrieves the AndroidFacet associated with the given artifact within the project.

methods.name: chooseAndroidApplicationModule
methods.description: Displays a dialog for selecting an Android module from a list of facets and returns the selected facet.
